analysis:
Integration of 23 units. Changes: (a) NemotronSuperServingPolicy.maximumEncodedBodyBytes 8 MiB to 40 MiB (NemotronSuperServingPolicy.swift ~line 369); (b) new Failure.bodyTooLarge in NemotronSuperLocalImageBinding.encodedHeaderQuote, mapped to MediaError.mediaTooLarge in NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP (~178); (c) NemotronSuperRequestPlan drops the refusal of JSON response_format with tools, and NemotronSuperLocalOutput (~93-98) skips format normalization when validated tool calls exist; (d) test, doc and changelog updates, including smaller default prefix bank expectations.

Memory/availability (TB-007, T-010, T-029): the ingress quote is bodyBytes*32 + templateBytes*4 + 16 MiB. That is about 1.28 GiB at 40 MiB, up from about 272 MiB. Worst-case media charge rises to 4.67 GiB per image. The size check precedes parse and decode, the reservation goes through the shared budget and fails closed with 503, and one media request runs at a time per owner. The local HTTP route is still capped by localInferenceMaxUploadBytes (32 MiB, answers 413), and the coordinator inbound limit is also 32 MiB, so the 40 MiB bound exceeds both transport limits and is effectively unreachable. The default prefix bank shrinks, which does not widen T-041. The Super local endpoint is an unregistered, default-absent hook that serves only the Super model, and auth is unchanged.

Tool plus JSON format: tool-call validation (ToolConstraintValidation) still runs first, forced tool_choice still needs its call, and non-JSON answers without calls fail with 422. No plaintext fallback (T-008). Content emitted next to tool calls is the provider's own output and skips JSON validation, which is a contract relaxation but not a confidentiality issue.

Unverified: callers' exhaustive handling of the new bodyTooLarge case outside the visible mapping, VisionMemoryGate behavior under repeated large reservations, and temp-file avoidance for inline video (T-050). Only tests, docs and changelog changed otherwise; no key, attestation, authorization or cache-storage changes. No concrete regression found.
